name: Desiccant Technology Corporation
summary: Desiccant Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial dehumidification, drying, and pollution control equipment in Taiwan and China. The company also offers air purification and processing, air treatment equipment, plastic processing, and energy-saving equipment, as well as its spare parts. In addition, it provides volatile organic gases exhaust abatement systems, rotary regenerative and catalytic thermal oxidizers, waste liquid/wastewater thermal oxidizer systems; organic solvent recovery equipment, heat exchangers, ultra-low dew-point desiccant adsorption equipment, chemical filters, and sludge thermal oxidizers and drying systems.
